item.title: Jonathan Wellum: A Biblical View of Taxes & Tariffs [Ezra Interviews with Michael Thiessen]
item.description:
In this episode of Ezra Interviews, Dr. Michael Thiessen speaks with financial advisor Rocklinc Investment's President and CEO Jonathan Wellum about the complexities of taxation, government roles, inflation, and tariffs. They explore the biblical perspective on taxation, the implications of government expansion, and the impact of inflation on individual wealth. The discussion also delves into the fairness of tariffs in international trade and the need for a reevaluation of government policies in Canada and the US.
